snippet.title: I AM RIPPER | Announce Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Now!
STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3218100/I_AM_RIPPER/
EPIC: https://store.epicgames.com/en-US/p/i-am-ripper-031b47
GOG: https://www.gog.com/en/game/i_am_ripper

I AM RIPPER, a new thriller from White Paper Games.

CONTENT WARNING: Our new game includes scenes of drowning, death and body mutilation which some players may find distressing.

I AM RIPPER is a British Thriller set in the brutality and economic decline of the 1980's. You are a forensic investigator called on to solve one of the UK's most prolific crimes.

#GameDev #UE5 #TrailerTuesday
